verdicts.reason: A has a clean top-to-bottom story order with even left margins and a clear gap between headline and subcopy, but the 'now.' orphan, the CTA crowded toward the bottom, and the stray cream circle fragment in the bottom-left corner all need fixing. B jams the headline and subcopy against a ~6px left edge, puts the subcopy tight under the headline with no gap, crowds the rotated badge against the top edge, and has the same stray circle fragment and orphaned 'now.'.
